🛡️ How This Ties to SonicWall

Cloud Security (73% CAGR): SonicWall's traditional strength in on-premise firewalls is being challenged. The market shift to cloud-native security presents both risk and opportunity for portfolio expansion.

Identity Management (63% CAGR): SonicWall currently lacks comprehensive identity solutions. This gap represents a strategic vulnerability as customers increasingly demand unified security platforms.

Zero-Trust Architecture: Competitors like Palo Alto and Zscaler are gaining market share with zero-trust offerings. SonicWall needs to modernise its architecture to remain competitive.
